caption: The drawing depicts a headless mannequin or figure dressed in a full-length, brown Victorian-style dress shown in profile, facing left. The dress is composed of a darker brown main body with long sleeves and a fitted bodice. The right sleeve features a small pointed cuff with a lighter beige or tan trim. The skirt is voluminous, particularly toward the back, where it is gathered and draped, forming a bustle that accentuates the rear. The bustle extends into a train made of a lighter beige or taupe fabric that contrasts against the darker brown main portion; this section of the train has sawtooth edging where it meets the darker fabric. Both the hem of the outer skirt and the ends of the sleeve cuffs are trimmed with a pleated, ruffled fabric in a slightly lighter tan shade. The entire scene has a neutral background with no other objects or adornments.
title: Dress
